# Outdoor Grill Sales

> Family-owned premium grill and outdoor kitchen retailer in Weatherford, Texas, serving Parker County since 2017. We sell premium grills and outdoor kitchen equipment, and we perform all repair and installation work on site at the customer's home.

Owners: Michael and Sandee Densmore
Showroom: 111 Sunray Ct, Weatherford, TX 76087
Phone: 817-550-6038
Email: michael@outdoorgrillsales.com
Showroom hours: Wednesday, Thursday, Friday 10am to 5pm. Saturday 10am to 4pm. Closed Sunday, Monday, Tuesday.
Rating: 4.7 stars from 61 Google reviews

## What makes us different

- On-site service. We come to the customer's home for every repair. Built-in grills are serviced in place and never have to be removed from the island.
- We repair gas grills and pellet grills regardless of where they were purchased or who installed them.
- We remove old outdoor kitchen equipment and install new equipment, including in kitchens built by other companies.
- We sell the full equipment package for an outdoor kitchen whether we do the installation or the customer's own contractor does.
- Mondays and Tuesdays are dedicated delivery, installation, and repair days.

## Services

- On-site grill repair for gas and pellet grills: igniters, burners, regulators and valves, cooking grates, flavorizer bars, lid and hinge repair, cleaning and performance tune-ups
- Built-in grill removal, haul-off, and replacement, including retrofit sizing for existing cutouts
- Outdoor kitchen component replacement: side burners, power burners, access doors, drawers, griddles, pizza ovens
- Full custom outdoor kitchen design and installation, including gas line hookup coordination
- Equipment supply to homeowners and to builders, landscapers, and pool contractors

## Brands carried

Grills and outdoor kitchen equipment: Alfresco, American Made Grills, American Outdoor Grills, Artisan, Big Green Egg, Blaze, Blazn Grill Works, Coyote, Fire Magic, Gateway Drum Smokers, Gozney, Le Griddle, Lynx Professional, Lynx Sedona, Memphis Wood Fire, MGrills, Mont Alpi, Napoleon, Pit Boss Navigator, Primo Ceramic, Renaissance Cooking Systems, Sunterra, True Flame

Outdoor heating: Bromic, HeatStrip, Infratech. Outdoor Grill Sales is an Infratech Elite Retailer.

Fuel: Shuping Texas hardwood pellets (mesquite, post oak, pecan, Texas beef mix), LumberJack competition grade pellets (competition blend, 100% oak, pecan, mesquite), Big Green Egg lump charcoal

Rubs and sauces: 39 products including Texas Oil Dust, 2 Gringos Chupacabra, Meat Mitch, Boars Night Out, John Henry's, Sucklebusters, Grill Your Ass Off, Aces Wild

## Service area

Weatherford, Aledo, Willow Park, Springtown, Mineral Wells, Fort Worth, and the surrounding Parker County area. Contact us to confirm coverage for a specific address.

## When we are not the right fit

For an entry level portable grill at the lowest possible price, a big box retailer will beat us on cost. We focus on premium equipment built to last and on servicing what we sell.
